title: eludite.settings.get output
description: The settings files and the settings, in the order of the settings schema.

user_file.description: The user settings file: where it is, whether it exists, and why it could not be read (it is then ignored).

solution_file.description: The open solution's (or folder's) `.eludite/settings.json`; omitted when nothing is open.

user_workspace_file.description: The person's own state for the open workspace, which holds the `user-workspace` settings (`x-eludite-scope`, such as browser.allowNoSandbox): `<config dir>/eludite/workspaces/<folder name>-<16 hex digits>/settings.json`; omitted when nothing is open or Eludite's config directory is unknown.

source.description: Where the value came from: the schema's default, the user file, the solution file, the person's state for the workspace (`user-workspace`), or an environment variable.

env.description: The environment variable that overrides it, when it has one.

ignored_keys.description: Keys found in the solution's `.eludite/settings.json` that are the person's own (`x-eludite-scope: user-workspace`, such as browser.allowNoSandbox): their values there are ignored, never applied.

unknown_keys.description: Keys found in a settings file that the schema does not know; they are ignored.
